title: Had Fable 5.2 build a COD-inspired Zombies game
author: Rare_Guide_9830
selftext:
Saw people were building these insane games with Fable 5.2 as single HTML files using Three.js so I had to try it out. This was the first version after about a 14 hour run. I burned about 120% worth of weekly fable limit on it thus far.

Play here: [https://zombies.ethanplus.ai/](https://zombies.ethanplus.ai/)

Repo: [https://github.com/ethanplusai/zombies](https://github.com/ethanplusai/zombies)

I build a lot of stuff with AI but new to games. This opened a whole new world for me honestly. Will definitely keep going on this. Super basic now but just insane what this model can do with very little direction.
